name: Transparent Hair Oil Applicator Comb | Refillable Scalp Massage Comb with Built-In Oil Reservoir | Leakproof Hair Serum Distribution Brush | Unisex
description:
Make hair oiling easier and cleaner with the Transparent Refillable Hair Oil Applicator Comb. Designed with a built-in liquid reservoir, this applicator comb helps distribute hair oil, serum, or other suitable liquid hair-care products directly onto the scalp while the comb teeth help spread the product evenly. The transparent reservoir lets you easily monitor the remaining liquid, while the compact design makes it convenient for regular home use or travel. Its controlled application helps reduce messy hands and unnecessary product wastage during your hair-care routine.

How to Use
Open the liquid reservoir carefully
Fill it with your preferred hair oil or suitable liquid hair-care product
Close the reservoir securely
Gently press or operate the applicator to release the liquid
Move the comb slowly through the scalp and hair
Massage and distribute the product evenly
Clean the applicator after use

Transparent Plastic Body
Built-In Liquid Reservoir
Comb Teeth
Oil Distribution Applicator
Scalp Massage Structure

Safety Information
Use only with suitable liquid hair-care products
Do not fill with thick or unsuitable liquids that may block the applicator
Keep the reservoir securely closed to help prevent leakage
Clean thoroughly before refilling with a different product
Do not share without properly cleaning the applicator
Stop use if skin irritation occurs
Keep away from excessive heat and direct sunlight
